settings.anchorsEmpty: No anchored frequency. Without anchors, doses are counted from the time of the prescription.
settings.anchorsHint: When the veterinarian prescribes q8h, the doses land at these hours, and the sheet builds the day's grid on its own.
settings.anchorsWarning: Changing anchor times does NOT rewrite tasks already created. Open hospitalizations keep the grid they were given; the new anchor applies from the next prescription onward.
settings.complianceProfileHint: Sets how patients are identified, what the responsible party is called, and how long records are kept. Choose it once, at rollout: once patients carry identifiers, the switch is refused so no identifier is orphaned.
settings.defaultPrescriptionsEmpty: No default prescriptions. Every chart starts blank.
settings.defaultPrescriptionsHint: Created with the hospitalisation, with a time and a window like any prescription. The vet can still remove them case by case.
settings.footer: Everything that shows up on the treatment sheet starts here: the anchor hours become the dose grid and the tolerances become the late warnings.
settings.forbidden: Only the clinic administrator changes these settings. Ask whoever administers it, or sign in with your own administrator account. Station mode never configures the clinic.
settings.newKeyHint: Save it now: the key is shown once. The system only stores its cryptographic digest.
settings.occupancyNoLimit: {{active}} patients hospitalized right now. No bed limit configured.
settings.pinHint: Each person's PIN is set on the team screen. The PIN is what stamps a name and professional license onto every clinical act.
settings.regionHint: The time zone drives dose times, the per-day hospitalization charge and what shows up on the medical record.
settings.rotateConfirm: Do this when a tablet or computer goes missing, or when the key may have leaked.
settings.rotateWarning: Generating a new key disconnects EVERY device that signs in with it, at once. Individually enrolled devices are unaffected.
settings.section.clinicHint: Name, plan and how many patients the clinic can keep hospitalized at once.
settings.section.hoursHint: The times set here build the task grid of every treatment sheet.
settings.section.regionHint: Language, currency, units and time zone. It is the time zone that decides what time each dose lands.
settings.section.rulesHint: Lateness windows and the prescriptions that come ready at admission.
settings.section.securityHint: How shared devices get into the clinic and how each person identifies on them.
settings.stationKeyHint: One password for every device. It still works for anyone who has not migrated, but revoking it is all or nothing: use Devices to enrol new ones.
settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.tolerancesHint: How many minutes a task may run past its time before the system calls it late. In minutes.
settings.timezoneRejected: The API did not recognise this time zone. Use the IANA name, like America/Sao_Paulo.
settings.anchorsRejected: The API rejected the anchor times. Each frequency needs at least one HH:MM time.
settings.copyFailed: Could not copy. Copy the key by hand before closing: it is never shown again.
settings.clinic.letterheadHint: Appears on the letterhead of the record given to the owner.
settings.rulesHint: How the system decides what is late and what is prescribed from the start. Applies to the whole clinic.
settings.toleranceHint.critical: Critical drugs, controlled substances and anything the prescription marked as critical.
settings.toleranceHint.normal: The common case: a scheduled prescription more frequent than once a day.
settings.toleranceHint.daily: Once a day or wider, such as the progress note and the owner call.
settings.toleranceEffect: Late is worked out at read time, never stored: changing the window changes the wall board, the shift queue and the handover at once, including for what is already prescribed.
settings.toleranceRange: Each window runs from 5 minutes to 24 hours. Outside that it is not saved: zero would make every task born late, and a week would make late never happen.
settings.ceremonyDaily: Once a day, every day of the stay.
settings.devicesHint: Each shared tablet and computer with its own access: you can see which exist, when they were last used, and take one offline without knocking out the others.
settings.planChange: The limit is a warning, not a block: no admission is refused because of it. To change plan or limit, contact PlantãoVet.
